info.name: CSEDU Digital Knowledge Platform API v1
info.description:
Complete REST API for the CSEDU Digital Knowledge Platform (CSE 4113 — Internet Programming Lab, Team Devops).

**Base URL:** `https://devops.farefin.com/api/v1`

## Quick start
1. Select the **CSEDU — Production** environment.
2. Run **Auth → Login (admin)**. The test script stores `accessToken` automatically; every other request inherits it via collection-level Bearer auth.
3. Set the id variables (`catalogId`, `itemId`, `loanId`, …) from any list response.

## Conventions
- REST over JSON, versioned by URL prefix (`/api/v1`).
- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>` (JWT, 1-hour TTL, 7-day refresh token).
- Errors: `{"error": "message"}` with 400 / 401 / 403 / 404 / 409 / 500.
- List endpoints: `page`, `per_page`, and a `total` count for server-side pagination.
- `OptionalAuth` routes work anonymously but widen their result set when a token is sent.

## Roles
`public` < `student` < `researcher` < `librarian` < `administrator`. Role checks run in `middleware.RequireRole`, which reads the role from the signed JWT — never from the request body.

item.name: 1. Auth
item.description: Registration, password login, JWT refresh, Google OAuth 2.0 SSO, passwordless magic-link sign-in, profile and session management.

request.description: Public self-registration. The server always forces role_tier=student — a client-supplied `role` field is ignored (RBAC escalation fix). Returns an access + refresh token pair.

Password login. Stores access/refresh tokens into collection variables so every other request in this collection authenticates automatically. Run this first.

Account lockout: 5 consecutive failures locks the account for 15 minutes.
Switch the collection to a librarian session (circulation desk, fines, catalog writes).
Switch the collection to a student session (borrowing, holds, project submission).
Exchanges a valid refresh token (7-day TTL, hashed in `refresh_tokens`) for a new 1-hour access token. Revoked tokens are rejected server-side.
Which optional sign-in providers are configured. Drives UI gating: the "Continue with Google" button is hidden when GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID is unset.
Full-page redirect to Google's consent screen (SDD Flow 4). Not an XHR endpoint — open in a browser. Postman will follow the 302.
Google redirects here. The API exchanges the code, find-or-creates the user by email, and hands the token back to the frontend via URL fragment.
Passwordless email sign-in. Generates a single-use token in Redis and emails the link over SMTP. Also serves as the forgot-password path.
Consumes the emailed token and issues a session. Single-use, short TTL.
Current user profile from the bearer token.
Edit name/email. Email uniqueness is enforced by `uq_users_email`.
Requires the current password. New hash is bcrypt cost 12.
Revokes the refresh token server-side (`refresh_tokens.revoked = true`).

item.name: 2. Library — Catalog
item.description: Public catalog search with faceted filters; librarian-only writes.

request.description: Public, paginated catalog search. `q` runs PostgreSQL full-text search over title + author (GIN indexes). `topic` / `availability` drive the faceted filter tree. Server-side pagination — response carries `total` for the pager.
Distinct topic facets with counts, used to build the catalog filter hierarchy.
Single book record including copy counts and barcode.
Librarian/administrator only. ISBN is uniquely indexed (partial index, NULLs allowed) so CSV re-import upserts instead of duplicating. A barcode `B-xxxxxxxx` is assigned automatically by trigger.

item.name: 3. Library — Loans
item.description: Borrowing and returning, member and staff views.

request.description: Creates a loan for the calling user. Guarded by the partial unique index `idx_loans_active_user_item` (user_id, catalog_id WHERE return_date IS NULL) — the same user cannot hold two active loans on one title. Blocked when outstanding fines exceed FINE_BLOCK_THRESHOLD_BDT. Due date = now + LOAN_PERIOD_DAYS.
Loan history for the calling user.
Sets return_date, restores available_copies, and fulfils the oldest active hold on that title.
Librarian/administrator view across all members.
Dedicated loan-service equivalent of /library/loans.
Dedicated loan-service return.
Dedicated loan-service history.

item.name: 4. Library — Circulation Desk
item.description: Barcode-driven checkout/return for the librarian desk.

request.description: Circulation desk. HID barcode scanners appear as keyboards, so the API receives plain strings; trailing \r/\n are stripped server-side. Resolves member + item, then creates the loan in one transaction.
Returns whatever active loan is attached to that item barcode.
Resolves a scanned code to either a member or a catalog item so the desk UI can show context before committing.
Reserves an unavailable title. Librarians are rejected (403). One active hold per user per item.
Active/fulfilled holds for the calling user.
Cancels an active hold.
Queue view for librarians.

item.name: 6. Library — Fines & Payments
item.description: Overdue fines, simulated bKash/Nagad OTP gateway, in-person cash settlement, waivers.

request.description: Fines owed by the calling user.
Direct settlement path. Writes a `payments` row and flips the fine to paid.

Simulated bKash/Nagad gateway. Opens a `payment_sessions` row and returns a demo OTP (`demo_otp`) instead of calling a real PSP — gateway integration is out of scope per the SDD. One live session per fine (partial unique index).
Verifies the OTP, marks the session completed, inserts the payment, settles the fine.
Marks the fine as awaiting in-person counter payment; appears in the librarian queue.
Cancels the member's open payment session.
Every fine, for librarians.
Sessions with status `awaiting_counter` waiting on a librarian to take cash.
Librarian confirms cash received; records `confirmed_by` for the audit trail.
Sets fine status to `waived` with a reason. Audit-logged.
Manually triggers the same overdue calculation the fine-worker cron runs nightly. `UNIQUE(loan_id)` on fines makes repeat runs idempotent.
All overdue, unsettled loans.
Staff-side settlement through the dedicated fine service.

item.name: 7. Media & Archive
item.description: Polymorphic uploads (archive / research / project), access-tiered downloads from MinIO, metadata editing, RAG ingestion triggers.

request.description: Polymorphic listing over `media_items` (archive | research | project). Results are filtered by the caller's access_tier — anonymous callers only ever see `public` rows. OptionalAuth: works with or without a token, but returns more with one.
Single item with its 1:1 metadata record (tags, abstract, keywords, language).
Streams the binary from MinIO. `inline=true` renders in-browser (PDF viewer); omit it to force download. Access tier is re-checked on every request.

multipart/form-data. Binary goes to MinIO, metadata to PostgreSQL, then an ingestion job is queued in Redis. The worker extracts text, chunks at 512 tokens / 50 overlap, embeds with MiniLM and writes 768-dim vectors to pgvector (SDD Flow 1).

formdata.value: Lecture notes covering lexical analysis and parsing.

formdata.description: YouTube/external link instead of a file

request.description: Items created by the calling user, with ingestion status.
Owner/admin metadata edit. Array params are cast (`::text[]`) inside the upsert so pgx infers the right type through COALESCE.
Swaps the stored binary and re-queues ingestion so the vector index stays in sync.
Cascades to research_papers / student_projects / vector_embeddings / rag_index_state, clears resource_reviews and removes the MinIO object.

item.name: 8. Research Papers
item.description: Submission, peer review and publication workflow (SDD Flow 5).

request.description: Published papers, publicly listable. `rtype` is derived (journal / conference / preprint) from which field is populated — no extra column.
Single paper joined across media_items + media_metadata + research_papers. Date columns are returned via `to_char()` because pgx cannot scan timestamptz into *string.
Creates the media_item + metadata + research_papers rows in one transaction. Starts in `draft` (SDD Flow 5).

item.name: 10. AI Assistant (RAG)
item.description: Hybrid-retrieval RAG chat, SSE streaming, per-document summarisation.

request.description: RAG query (SDD Flow 2). The Go API attaches the caller's role tier, the Python service embeds the query with MiniLM, runs hybrid retrieval (pgvector cosine + PostgreSQL FTS) fused by reciprocal rank, and sends the grounded context to Groq — falling back to Gemini on failure. Rows the caller may not read are filtered out before the LLM sees them, so the model cannot leak restricted documents. Identical queries are cached in Redis for 5 minutes to protect the free-tier quota.
Same pipeline, streamed as Server-Sent Events so tokens render progressively. This is the platform's real-time transport — nginx keeps a 30s timeout on /api/v1/ai/.
Multi-turn history for a session from `ai_chat_messages`, including the model used and cited source document IDs.
Per-resource AI summary of an indexed document. `language: bn` returns Bangla.

item.name: 11. Reviews & Ratings
item.description: 1–5 star ratings and comments on any resource.

request.description: Public ratings + comments for a resource, with the aggregate average.
One review per user per item (`UNIQUE(item_id, user_id)`); posting again updates the existing row. Rating is CHECK-constrained to 1–5. Notifies the resource owner.
In-app feed (hold available, review decision, role decision, overdue). The bell polls this endpoint — there is no WebSocket.
Marks one notification read.
Clears the unread badge.

item.name: 13. Role Requests
item.description: Verified role-upgrade requests with university ID evidence.

request.description: Any authenticated user. `university_id` and `evidence_url` are mandatory — a partial unique index allows only one pending request per user.
Uploads the ID card and returns the `evidence_url` to attach to the request.

formdata.description: Photo/scan of the university ID card

request.description: Status of the caller's own requests.

item.name: 14. Admin
item.description: User management, CSV import/export, moderation, audit log, role decisions.

request.description: Researcher/librarian/administrator. Member directory.
Streams the whole catalog as CSV for offline editing.
Bulk upsert keyed on ISBN. Rows without an ISBN are inserted; rows with one update the existing record.
Moderation: draft | review | published | archived.
Administrator only — the single legitimate path to a privileged role. Self-service escalation through /auth/register is blocked.
Append-only audit trail (row-level security allows INSERT only). Retained ≥ 90 days.
Pending role-upgrade requests with university ID and uploaded evidence.
Streams the applicant's uploaded ID card for verification.
Approving promotes the user and notifies them in-app + by email.
Public liveness probe. Returns `{"status":"ok","service":"csedu-api","version":"v1"}`. Used by Docker healthchecks, the deploy script and external uptime monitoring.

item.name: 16. Ops (internal only)
item.description: Root-level health and the Prometheus scrape endpoint. These live on the server root, outside /api/v1, and are only reachable from inside the Docker network — nginx does not proxy them. Set `rootUrl` to http://localhost:8080 and run them from the VM.

request.description: Original root-level probe. Reachable only from inside the Docker network or the VM (`curl localhost:8080/health`) — nginx proxies `/api/v1/` only. Point `rootUrl` at http://localhost:8080 when running these from the server.

Prometheus scrape target — `infra/prometheus` scrapes `api:8080/metrics` over the private Docker network. Request counts, latency histograms and status-code series per route. Deliberately NOT exposed publicly.
